title: Version 0 wording implies an operational uncompressed fallback registry
description: spec/03-adaptation.md labels Rule Set Version 0 as Reserved (uncompressed fallback), and rule_versioning.json says version 0 is reserved for uncompressed fallback. Current policy says Version 3 is the only operational registry and Rule 255 syntax is version-independent only under narrow out-of-DODAG policy. Clarify that version 0 is simply reserved and never activates a fallback registry; Rule 255 does not make v0 operational.
